comparison.policy: Local three-repeat rows plus separately displayed paper-reported classical values; EFF-Dock explicitly taken from current unguided/refined/chirality paper condition. All other native protocols retained; no equal-budget claim.

complexity_budget.spread: sample SD across three sampling seeds; not a target-generalization CI
complexity_budget.budget_selection: original generation-order prefix, reranked within prefix; no full-bank selection leakage
complexity_budget.prefix_pb: unavailable for reselected poses; no imputation
complexity_budget.fragment_source: actual saved trajectory fragment_id, all three repeats, no reconstruction

complexity_failures.scope: Post-hoc algebraic decomposition of existing descriptive bins; no new causal experiment.
complexity_failures.partition: 100-O, O-T, T-J, J; O=refined RMSD oracle, T=filtered RMSD Top1, J=joint official PB Top1
complexity_failures.denominator: all complexes in each bin, averaged equally over the same three repeats
complexity_failures.coverage_note: Absence from refined bank cannot isolate original sampler from refinement effects.
complexity_failures.selection_note: Includes chirality-mask exclusions; not exclusively a confidence error.
complexity_failures.conditional_note: 100 * total Top1 successes / total oracle successes over three repeats; not mean of per-repeat ratios
